tool_args.rationale: The supply-bullwhip bridge points to the inland-hub siphon, but the pilot has no sink-gradient variation. The open-branch probe can distinguish its branch and sink dependence from competing mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so sink inhibition and branch behavior are not independently identified.
The bridge and flux-conservation signatures favor the static siphon; a trajectory batch is not yet justified.
It does not resolve the relevant mechanism ambiguity.
